message.tm_wagon.server_only: Parts can only be installed on the server.
message.tm_wagon.wrong_slot: Wrong mounting position or wheel size. Small wheels go at the front, large wheels at the rear.
message.tm_wagon.occupied: This slot is occupied. Remove its part first.
message.tm_wagon.body_required: Place a wagon box on the assembly jack first.
message.tm_wagon.frame_required: Install this on an assembly jack or at a mounting point on the wagon box.
message.tm_wagon.out_of_bounds: Outside the build area or a required chunk is not loaded.
message.tm_wagon.blocked: Clear the entire area occupied by this part.
message.tm_wagon.entity_blocked: Move entities out of the installation area.
message.tm_wagon.controller_unloaded: Load the area containing the assembly jack before dismantling.
tooltip.tm_wagon.cargo_body: Right-click the top of the jack to place a wagon box with a footboard and steps on both sides. 10 cargo slots.
tooltip.tm_wagon.single_horse_shafts: Mount at the front center of the wagon box, below the footboard.
tooltip.tm_wagon.double_horse_shafts: Mount at the front center of the wagon box, below the footboard. Two hitched animals accelerate faster and reduce the cargo penalty on sprint speed.
tooltip.tm_wagon.single_seat: Mount above the footboard at the front center. Right-click the cushion to sit.
tooltip.tm_wagon.double_seat: Mount above the footboard at the front center. Right-click a cushion to sit; the left seat controls the wagon.
tooltip.tm_wagon.small_wheel: Fit to the front axle. A wagon requires two small front wheels.
tooltip.tm_wagon.large_wheel: Fit to the rear axle. A wagon requires two large rear wheels.
message.tm_wagon.frame_extend_first: Fully raise the assembly jack before installing parts.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_assembly_frame: Placed raised by default; sneak while placing to lower it. Right-click an empty jack to raise or lower it. Use a raised jack to assemble a complete wagon, or a lowered jack to return a wagon to block form.
message.tm_wagon.incomplete_assembly: Missing parts: a wagon box, a driver's seat or bench, shafts or a pole, two small front wheels and two large rear wheels are required.
message.tm_wagon.assembly_busy: Assembly or disassembly is in progress. Wait for the jack to finish moving.
message.tm_wagon.spawn_failed: Could not spawn the wagon. All components were preserved.
message.tm_wagon.wagon_missing: The wagon has left the jack or is no longer loaded.
message.tm_wagon.restore_failed: Cannot return the wagon to block form: %s The jack will lower again.
message.tm_wagon.seat_occupied: This seat is occupied. Choose another seat.
message.tm_wagon.lead_horse_required: Lead an adult horse, donkey, mule, skeleton horse or zombie horse here first.
message.tm_wagon.hitch_blocked: The horse needs clear space and nearby ground to stand on.
message.tm_wagon.cargo_unsupported: This block cannot be carried as cargo. Multi-block structures are not supported.
message.tm_wagon.cargo_filtered: The cargo filter does not allow this block.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_straw_mat: Occupies three consecutive empty slots in one column toward the front. Right-click to sleep without setting a respawn point; sneak-right-click to remove.
message.tm_wagon.mat_space: Not enough room: three consecutive empty slots away from you are required.
message.tm_wagon.mat_dimension: You cannot sleep in this dimension.
message.tm_wagon.mat_unstable: Stop and steady the wagon before sleeping.
message.tm_wagon.cargo_blocked: A block or entity is obstructing this cargo slot.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_stool: Place in a wagon cargo slot. Right-click to sit; sneak-right-click to remove.
message.tm_wagon.stool_cannot_sit: You cannot sit on this stool.
tooltip.tm_wagon.long_cargo_body: Right-click the top of the jack to place a wagon box with one extra row at the rear. 12 cargo slots.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_cargo_cover: Right-click the wagon side to fit, in block or entity form. Right-click the tarp to roll it back one row; sneak-right-click to unroll one row. Sneak-right-click an exposed wooden side to remove.
message.tm_wagon.cover_installed: This wagon box already has a tarpaulin.
message.tm_wagon.cover_side: Use a wooden side to fit or remove the tarpaulin. Use the fabric or rolled end to adjust it.
message.tm_wagon.cover_blocked: A block or entity is obstructing the tarpaulin. It cannot be moved.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_canopy: Right-click the wagon side to fit, in block or entity form; sneak-right-click an exposed wooden side to remove. Right-click either curtain to open or close it. Cannot be fitted with a tarpaulin.
message.tm_wagon.roof_conflict: A canvas hood and a tarpaulin cannot be fitted together.
message.tm_wagon.canopy_side: Use a wooden side to fit or remove the hood. Right-click either curtain to open or close it.
message.tm_wagon.canopy_blocked: A block or entity is obstructing the hood or curtain. It cannot be moved.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wagon_cabinet: Fit to the side beneath the driver's seat, in block or entity form. Sneak-right-click to remove and spill the contents. Right-click either drawer front to open. Single seat: 27 slots; benches: 54 slots.
message.tm_wagon.cabinet_side: Right-click the side beneath the driver's seat or either drawer front.
tooltip.tm_wagon.single_wooden_seat: Mount above the footboard at the front center. Right-click the seat top to sit. Can be fitted with a drawer cabinet.
tooltip.tm_wagon.double_wooden_seat: Mount above the footboard at the front center. Right-click the seat top to sit; the left seat controls the wagon. Can be fitted with a drawer cabinet.
tooltip.tm_wagon.wide_cargo_body: 32 cargo slots in four columns and eight rows. Centered on the assembly jack.
tooltip.tm_wagon.triple_seat: Fits wide wagon boxes only. The middle seat controls the wagon.
tooltip.tm_wagon.triple_wooden_seat: Fits wide wagon boxes only. The middle seat controls the wagon.
message.tm_wagon.cargo_container_protect: This container is locked or has ungenerated loot and cannot be used as interactive cargo.
task.tm_wagon.wagon_companion.desc: During work, takes a free seat beside the driver on a nearby assembled wagon. While seated, holding a bow, crossbow or TACZ gun lets her attack nearby hostiles without dismounting. Supply the ammunition used by her normal weapon tasks.
task.tm_wagon.wagon_passenger.desc: During work, finds a free stool with enough headroom in a nearby assembled wagon.
message.tm_wagon.handbook_requires_patch: Install Patchouli to read this handbook.
book.tm_wagon.handbook.landing: Welcome to Traveling Merchant Wagon. This handbook will guide you through assembling and using your wagon.$(br2)$(l:tm_wagon:start/assembly)Your First Wagon$(/l)$(br)$(l:tm_wagon:help/troubleshooting)Help & Integrations$(/l)
book.tm_wagon.recipe_unavailable: This recipe is unavailable on this server.
message.tm_wagon.sleeping_bag_space: Not enough room: two consecutive empty slots away from you are required.
